input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix cache corruption during concurrent tool installs

The CacheStore wrote content and metadata using plain fs::write,
which is not atomic. When multiple installations ran concurrently,
readers could observe partially written files or metadata/content
from different writers, resulting in corrupt cache entries.

Two changes fix this:
- Write both content and metadata via atomic temp-file-then-rename,
  so readers never see partially written data.
- Validate content length against metadata.size_bytes on read;
  return an error (treated as cache miss) if they disagree, which
  handles the remaining race between two separate renames.

The remote template loader now treats read_content errors as cache
misses, falling through to a network fetch instead of propagating
the error.
EOF
)"
